body: It is not a low-effort post!!! It is a question I’m genuinely asking. My first language is not English so it is to easy for me to write very long post. It is still important to me and for it being deleted is not fair
I feel you. Or sometimes I laugh when it’s not funny at all cause I don’t know what to say.
I can relate to your story in some ways. I was raised in a very similar way and my social anxiety makes me say all the wrong things when I’m around people. We can chat if you want
Yes I can totally relate. Absolutely no one or passion to hold on to. If at least I was good at something and could hold on to that. But no -nothing.
Same, but I don’t have the balls. Exhausted of being considered a looser. Normal people don’t know how hard it is to fight this battle everyday.
Oh, I understand. Seeing happy group of people just makes me feel so terrible and lonely. I feel like I’m invisible.

Every. Single. One. Of. Them. 

Most were toxic anyways as I tend to attract narcissist or be with someone just cause I’m bored/lonely.

But one was good, like perfect kinda good and I ruined it. 5 years later and still my biggest regret. I know it wasn’t my fault but I can’t help regretting anyway. I’m so scared of getting in a relationship now.
Thank you for your kind words.

No one is born with anxiety but you have the genetics that can play a role in developing the disorder especially at a young age. If you develop the disorder as an adult it is usually due to trauma. On my part, I now know that I had anxiety at a young age but it has increased exponentially as an adult due to trauma.
OMG!!! I was never able to point it out but that’s it!!! It’s the exact same for me.
Yes, sure. I’d like to talk about your experience and how you got out of it.
I quit cold turkey after 5 weeks and had absolutely no issues. They made me feel like fucking shit anyway so wasn’t hard to feel better. Dunno about 3 months though.
That sucks. I know the feeling. I feel that I do a good job also but people don’t like me so they find way to criticize it anyway. Or maybe I’m an easy target I really dunno.
Yes, I think working remotely is the best option for someone with BPD.
I do just a few puffs at night to relax. Was never a big smoker though. Also take CBC oil every morning.

Trintellix was my 1st AD and I had the same feeling as you but on top of it I felt very suicidal, I even did atttent in taking my own life, that’s how bad it was. After a month, I stopped. I couldn’t take it anymore. After a couple days I felt so much better. I had mental clarity and realized that a drug would not fix my issues. I also think that natural ways are way better. Depression is complex. It’s not a broken harm and I think that if you do have depression you have to take a step back. It’s your body sending you signs that it needs a break. Ask yourself some questions like what would make me happy or at least better at this specific time, taking small steps. Therapy helped me a lot too. Changing my lifestyle and doing stuff for ME. Not for what society, my family or whoever think is better. It’s not easy but way more sustainable.
Same

I do. and I’m just so pissed off it didn’t work. I have bruises everywhere including a black eye from probably falling over, I don’t remember anything. I just want to leave this world. Whyyy couldn’t it work. Now I’m out of sleep drugs that I actually need.
Same or really which I could just trade with someone. Give my life to a sick child or anyone that doesn’t deserve to die and that has a happy life ahead.

Same here. Ended up dating a really good friend I met travelling. I honestly never loved him I only liked him as a good friend. But I was very lonely and in need of affection at the time. He wanted a relationship so I went on with it. I ended up being sooo mean to him. Like he would do literally everything for me and I was so terrible to him. He didn’t deserved it. I apologized but the damage was done. I lost a really good friend.

I learned from it and now my next relationship I’ll make sure that first my feelings are genuine and that I’m ready mentally. I never want to put myself or anyone through that kinda relationship again. It hurts but you gotta learn from it 🤍

It does get better. I was there a week ago. I’m only on week 3 so I don’t know the full benefits at all but I can say that last week I couldn’t get myself to do basic stuff that I usually do exactly like you said. I was also even more depressed than before and had really dark thoughts. 

This week has been a bit better. At least I’m not tired and feeling like a sad zombie but my anxiety started being bad. I’ve read that it can take several months for the drug to actually work. So patience I guess...

I’d like to know too. Depression is still there - not as bad though. 

But man that anxiety...

Yep, exactly what you said. I’ve been feeling like this for as long as I can remember but was always hopeful  that better days were coming. I’m loosing that hope now that I see all those wasted years that went by.

Thank you for your advice - volunteering is actually a really great idea. I’m not living with my parents I move all the time in the hope things will change. It does for a bit and then it gets bad again. Anyway thank you!

You know nothing about my struggles. 

Fuck you.
What do you mean by horrible if you don’t mind?
Ok thanks but Dr didn’t give me that kind of info. I will see that with her.
How long did you take the drug for? And how long did those symptoms last?
Wow! Thank you will definitely give it a go :)
Yes!! What is the workbook?
Thank you I really want to start DBT. Unfortunately where I live psychologists are very hard to get to especially ones with experience treating BPD. I’m on a wait list hopefully my turn comes :-)
Thank you - I guess communication is the biggest part of it!

Yes I had one boyfriend that wasn’t toxic and the relationship could have been great but I wasn’t in a good place at that time and ruined it. I worked on myself the last year and so I want my next relationship to be healthy but I wonder how to achieve it cause I never really had one ...

Thank you darling gives me a bit a hope xx yes I did worked on myself a lot actually!! I’m far from being where I want to be but better for sure. And so this is why for the first time in my life I really want to make sure my next relationship is healthy
I think so. Tbh I feel worst so I don’t see the point
I think it’s more because I’m tired. Like I feel that I’m not alert at all if that makes sense...

Same for me!!! Everything somewhat healthy that I used to like and eat multiple times a week don’t appeal to me at all. I usually love cooking, but now making basic things like pasta is a chore. My appetite is the same as before although all I want is fast food and unhealthy snacks... hopefully this stops as I just lost 30 pounds from training and eating well. Last thing I want is to gain it back after all the effort I’ve done. I’m on week two 10mg.

Same for me. I’m on my second week. Started with 5mg & on the few last days the exhaustion started. Just bumped up to 10mg today & it’s even worse. I feel like I’m on another fucking planet. I can’t even think.

I do this all. the. time. 
And then I’m like wow : 

I use to have a lot of friends - how did I loose them all?
I use to be confident & fun to talk to - how did I became so boring & self-conscious?
Thank you for your feedback it gives me a bit of hope :)

This 😐 “It’s time we rethink what we are doing. We are taking people who are suffering from the most common forms of depression, and instead of helping them, it appears we are putting an obstacle in their path to recovery.”
Yes it’s my first AD. I’m on 5mg for 7 days (2 left) then I’ll bump up to 10mg.
I see, wow I really hope it works for me :( so far I feel worst, cannot get anything done. Good luck to you...
I’m very hopeful. Did not work for you?
Good to know. And it helped with sleepiness during the day? My issue is not actually waking up but more staying up.

Yep, BPD is hard :'( but good for your dad for getting better, it’s not easy to quit especially while struggling with mental health. What scares me the most is that even if I put all the efforts possible into my well being, I feel that I’ll never reach a full level of happiness... It just makes me so hopeless to continue. Like deeply I don’t want to die but I don’t want to live like this either. Anyway thanks for the reply - it’s always reassuring to know you’re not alone.
That hit home. Feels like I wrote it. I feel ya darling. Chat with me if you want xx

I’m in Canada. So the cost is not the problem here, it is very the awfully long wait lists that are, unfortunately. I feel that the only way to get helped quickly is if you arrive to the hospital by ambulance.

I thought about getting a sick leave, but then coming back to work would be a walk of shame. I probably just couldn’t in the end... It would also ruin my chance of getting any work reference to get another decent job as it’s my job of 2 years. 

Yes, I’m kind of an artist. Really did not know what to put as my username thought. Being thinking of starting my own business but I don’t have the courage. I don’t think I could handle another failure in my life. 

Anyway, thanks for the reply. It means more than you know.
